SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-10: FHIRPath — §5.6.6-§5.6.12 String Manipulation (Transform). Test these items: upper(), lower(), replace(pattern, substitution), matches(regex), replaceMatches(regex, substitution), length(), toChars(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Archived in ARCHIVE_LOG.md under FP-10 SKEPTIC - Iteration 1 - 2026-05-16.
issues.root_cause: C++ evaluator transform paths called toString() on inputs or arguments before enforcing FHIRPath §5.6 singleton String type constraints.
issues.resolution: Added singleton and effectiveType(String) guards for native matches(), replace(), replaceMatches(), and toChars(); invalid replaceMatches regex now returns empty instead of original data. Rebuilt and copied bundled fhirpath.duckdb_extension.

issues.root_cause: Direct Python string helper module had older partial-regex semantics and did not expose toChars in STRING_FUNCTIONS.
issues.resolution: Changed direct helper matches() to fullmatch with DOTALL, made replace_matches() return input unchanged for empty regex, and added to_chars()/toChars registry entry.
